_comment: The ONE settings file for both deployments. Copy to config/<tenant>.json, edit, then run: python bulkaccess.py apply --config config/<tenant>.json. Credentials are NOT stored here: set SAIL_BASE_URL, SAIL_CLIENT_ID and SAIL_CLIENT_SECRET (a PAT of an ORG_ADMIN) in the environment or in the .env file named below.

inc.message: Enter a ServiceNow incident number: INC followed by 7 digits, e.g. INC0012345.

people._comment: max: null = no limit (the Launcher form is always capped at 30 by SailPoint). Requests above partSize (at most 250, SailPoint's workflow loop limit) are sent as several approvals with the same INC.

temporaryAccess._comment: Lets requesters choose access that is removed automatically. The Launcher offers durations only; the plugin also offers an end date.

access._comment: Who approves requests for the Launcher Access profile: MANAGER (the requester's manager) or NONE (auto-approved).

approvals._comment: The plugin's Approvals tab: item approvers (access profile owners, managers, ...) approve or deny everything one bulk request (one INC) created for them in one action, as their own decision. concurrency: 1..8 decisions at a time. useBulkEndpoint: auto, always or never (SailPoint's 50-at-a-time bulk endpoint). maxRows: 250..20000 pending approvals loaded. showOther: also list approvals that aren't from a bulk request. Approvers who aren't ORG_ADMIN need to see the plugin (plugin.public, or the plugin's restrictToUsers).
